observed_value: cost_currency values U_GBP, U_AUD, and U_EUR
anchor_value: USD cost column shown by Schedule of Investments Cost column and dollar-denominated cost subtotals

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Header places Principal Amount, Par Value or Shares before Cost; the foreign currency marker is in the principal/par column, not the Cost column.
Hamsard 3778 Limited term loan shows GBP principal/par marker with Cost 3,612 and Fair Value 3,486.
Ancora Bidco PTY LTD term loan shows AUD 5,191 in principal/par, followed by Cost 3,345 and Fair Value 3,151.
Van Der Steen term loan shows EUR principal/par marker with Cost 3,448 and Fair Value 3,407.
Pitch MidCo B.V. term loan shows EUR principal/par marker with Cost 2,981 and Fair Value 2,967.
Total Debt Investments United Kingdom subtotal shows dollar marker for Cost 6,460 and dollar marker for Fair Value 6,327.
Total Debt Investments Netherlands subtotal shows dollar marker for Cost 7,886 and dollar marker for Fair Value 7,860.

findings.detail: FX03 is a real cost_currency extraction defect: foreign principal/par units were assigned to cost_currency even though the Cost column is USD-denominated.

rationale: The filing schedule separates Principal Amount, Par Value or Shares from Cost. The flagged rows show GBP, AUD, or EUR in the principal/par area, while their Cost amounts appear under the Cost column and roll into dollar-denominated cost subtotals. Therefore the non-USD cost_currency values are not source-supported cost units; they are a column/unit extraction error.
